title: Retribute

inlines.v: RETRIB'UTE, verb transitive [Latin retribuo; re and tribuo, to give or bestow.] To pay back; to make payment, compensation or reward in return; as, to retribute one for his kindness; to retribute to a criminal what is proportionate to his offense.
